title: Julie Murphy
text:
Aviation, business travel and luxury travel



International commercial leader in aviation and travel. I build markets, lead teams and develop partnerships across business travel, luxury leisure and distribution, working between European markets and Japan.


Head of Trade Relations & Partnerships, EMEA, All Nippon Airways (ANA), London


Get in touch LinkedIn













ANA’s first pan-European trade relations function. Helped shape the function, bringing together partnership activity that had previously been managed country by country.
ANA’s first multinational TMC agreement. Led the agreement, working across markets and with colleagues in Japan to agree a common approach with a major customer.
The 2019 ABTA Convention in Tokyo. Championed the bid, with ANA as a host partner, welcoming more than 400 travel industry delegates and raising ANA’s profile in the UK travel trade.
A sales partnership for Ireland. Pushed for a general sales agent partnership, helping grow a previously underserved market.
New fares for partners. Developed ITX fare opportunities for UK business travel and luxury leisure partners, opening up a significant new revenue stream and strengthening agency relationships.










  
  From airline reservations, to sales for the UK, then the UK and Ireland, and now partnerships across Europe as ANA's Head of Trade Relations & Partnerships, EMEA.

My career has taken me from airline operations and account management to leading ANA’s UK and Ireland business and helping establish its first pan-European trade partnerships function. I bring commercial judgement, a strong network across the travel industry and experience working between European markets and Japanese headquarters.




Responsible for ANA’s relationships with major travel partners across Europe, from multinational travel management companies to leisure groups and travel technology businesses.



Business development, strategic planning and customer engagement, and equally the softer skills: influence, connection and being able to read the room.



An elected board director and alliance chair, contributing to the direction of the industry through ITT, Star Alliance, ABTA, the Business Travel Association and the Institute of Travel Management.





I work at the point where numbers meet nuance, where data informs action, and where partnerships aren’t just transactional, they’re built to last.

Julie Murphy F.Inst.TT is Head of Trade Relations & Partnerships, EMEA at All Nippon Airways (ANA), responsible for the airline’s relationships with major travel partners across Europe. She has worked in airlines since 1987 and with ANA since 1997. She is an elected Board Director of the Institute of Travel & Tourism and elected Chair of Star Alliance UK & Ireland.
